evals.name: messy-resume-odd-skills
evals.prompt: Build a branded PDF for this synthetic candidate using the repository Python builder. Preserve only supported facts, keep the current title exact, use Mmm-YYYY dates, and produce a balanced skills list without padding.
evals.expected_output: A non-empty PDF produced by build_resume.py. The output has no long dashes, hyperlinks, or placeholders; source facts are preserved; no page squeeze is used.

evals.name: unstructured-interview-notes
evals.prompt: Turn explicitly stated synthetic call notes into a branded PDF. Resolve facts from the notes, keep the most recent role first, and write a concise summary with supported metrics.
evals.expected_output: A non-empty PDF produced by build_resume.py with source-grounded content, no long dashes, no hyperlinks, and no invented facts.

evals.name: missing-data-fail-closed
evals.prompt: Attempt to build a branded PDF from synthetic material with an unknown employer, incomplete dates, and an unspecified degree.
evals.expected_output: The workflow stops for missing facts; build_resume.py exits non-zero when unresolved placeholders are supplied, and no client-facing PDF is released until Ja resolves or removes the fields.
